tools.name: project_metadata_manager
tools.title: Project Metadata Manager
tools.description:
This tool is a file metadata manager, designed to store and manage relevant information about files for use across multiple LLM sessions.

This prevents the LLM from having to read files with large amounts of code.

Usage:

When you need to know how a file works, try reading its metadata first with this tool. This will prevent you from having to read the entire file's code to understand its function and contents. If the metadata doesn't exist, read the file and create the relevant metadata for future sessions.

When you create a file, use this tool to store relevant metadata about it, such as function names, interface or type names, enums, function descriptions, classes, usage, and functionality descriptions. You can also add tags if you wish.

When you update a file, update its metadata with your settings.

path.description: The path of the file to get or set the metadata

action.description: The action to perform. `read` to read the file metadata. `write` to write the metadata on the file.

metadata.description: The metadata message, in markdown format. Required if `action` argument is equal to `write`. Anything you think is relevant about the `path` file. It may include: Function names, logic description, usage manners, and arbitrary tags.

oneOf.title: Completed Action
oneOf.description: The action was completed succesfully. Returned if the tool stored the metadata correctly.

oneOf.title: Action Filed
oneOf.description: The action failed. Returned if there ocurred some error storing the file metadata.

oneOf.title: Success Action
oneOf.description: Success. Returned if the file metadata was returned with success.

oneOf.title: File Not Found
oneOf.description: File not found in metadata database. The LLM never wrote metadata for this file.

metadata.description: The metadata content of the file. Only available if `status` is equal to `success`.
